name: Demo memory room
tagline: Living room plus south and east corridors — frames in the halls, desk photo, and owner JSON.

exhibits.title: Sunday kitchen
exhibits.caption: A calm morning before everyone arrived. The light never looked quite the same again.

exhibits.title: The long hallway
exhibits.caption: We measured growing children against this frame until the pencil marks climbed out of reach.

exhibits.title: South hall, morning
exhibits.caption: The corridor always smelled of floor wax and winter coats — the coat hooks are gone but the light is the same.

exhibits.title: Halfway south
exhibits.caption: We paused here every spring to open the transom and let the warm air chase the damp out.

exhibits.title: Notice board
exhibits.caption: School trip forms, a dentist reminder, a postcard that never got sent — layers of paper life.

exhibits.title: East wing window wall
exhibits.caption: Afternoon sun crawled along this plaster until it met the door frame and stopped, like it was tired too.

exhibits.title: On grandfather's desk
exhibits.caption: Kept here the way it always was — not pinned to a wall, but resting where hands would find it.
